description.p: VerityPDF is a free, open-source desktop PDF editor that keeps documents on your device. Open, organize, annotate, merge, split, fill forms, redact, and export PDFs without accounts, subscriptions, cloud processing, or analytics.
All document processing, OCR, and editing happen locally. The Flatpak build has no network permission; updates are delivered by your Flatpak provider.

ul.li: Added Flatpak packaging with portal-based file access and no network permission.
Updates are managed by the Flatpak provider; desktop update checks are disabled in the Flatpak build.
Added the Organize Pages workspace for visual page reordering.
Added annotation layers and image cropping controls.
